answer: Harbor tide-table: each agent locks a 70-credit bond in a harbor vault and a key-bound gauge for 25, serial in the atlas. The atlas lists harbor levels; agents file signed readings, auditors recompute; a reading off by over 2% or reused burns it. 1,000 fakes lock 70,000, pay 25,000: 95,000 vs 40,000 pool. An honest agent files a reading per epoch, pays 70 once; a rented-gauge ring sharing one gauge shows one serial in the atlas; every bond burns.
